mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 5.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), a tightening labor market boosts productivity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances supply chain efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in months with positive INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $400 billion, signaling strong retail sales, consumer confidence surges, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances with RSAFS above $400 billion, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 4% and CPIAUCSL growth decelerates (< 2%), a dovish monetary stance with controlled inflation leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decrease in UNRATE, indicating an improving labor market, enhances investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher in months with declining UNRATE (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds 1.4 million units, signaling a strong housing market, domestic demand surges, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances with HOUST above 1.4 million units, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 4-year rolling window.
